_why: Round 6, from Destin's review-5 AR5-2: the Look box moves directly under Layout and is named 'Additional Customizations'. Whole-panel pictures have the popup's height cap lifted in the screenshot only.
title: Appearance panel — round 6: Additional Customizations under Layout

steps.headline: Additional Customizations now sits right under the Layout pictures, above your themes.
steps.changed: The Look section and its heading are gone. The same box, renamed Additional Customizations, is now the last thing in Layout. It opens in place exactly as before.
steps.notice: Opening it pushes your themes further down the panel, so you'll scroll a little to reach them while it's open.
